name: Ona Ken!
source: Kasukabe Nao, who masturbates every day, decides to form a club to discuss masturbation, so as to get new ideas for the ultimate masturbation. She forces her childhood friend, Natsuigawa Hibiki, her classmate, Akiru Norika, and an upperclassman, Fuyutou Mako, to join her in the club.
translation: 每天自慰的春日部奈绪决定成立一个讨论自慰的俱乐部，从而为终极自慰获得新的想法。她强迫儿时好友夏井川响、同班同学秋留纪香和学长冬藤真子加入俱乐部。
